note: The archive input source is opened for reading and becomes the object later reused by the archive.
The same source object is passed into archive parsing and retained in the zip_t state.
Discarding the archive invalidates every tracked open source associated with it.
The safety obligation is that a source must not later be reopened after the archive has invalidated it; this flag marks the source as closed.
A reopened invalidated source is dereferenced here; the UAF path reaches this check and subsequent access on freed source state.
